items.claim: Q2 FY2027 (three months to 26 July 2026): Reported 26 August 2026. Revenue $96.2bn, up 18% q/q and 106% y/y; Data Center $89.0bn (+117% y/y), Edge Computing $7.2bn (+27% y/y). GAAP and non-GAAP gross margin both 75.0%. GAAP operating income $63.7bn (+124% y/y). GAAP diluted EPS $2.46, non-GAAP $2.22 (non-GAAP no longer excludes stock-based compensation since Q1 FY2027). GAAP net income $59.7bn included $7.8bn of gains on equity securities. Free cash flow fell to $21.3bn from $48.6bn in Q1 as accounts receivable rose $22.3bn to $63.1bn. About $26.0bn returned via buybacks and dividends, with about $99.0bn left on the repurchase authorization. Revenue beat NVIDIA's own Q2 guidance of $91.0bn +/-2%; the briefing could not confirm the sell-side revenue consensus for Q2 itself, so the beat is measured against company guidance. Shares closed at $209.66 before the report and opened about 6% higher the next day.

Q2 FY2027 (quarter ended 26 July 2026): Two quarters since the FY2026 10-K (year ended 25 January 2026) show revenue roughly doubling y/y, receivables rising to $63.1bn from $38.5bn, long-term debt rising to $32.4bn from $7.5bn and $108.5bn of new guarantees, none of which the annual figures reflect; Q3 FY2027 results are due today, 17 November 2026.
Megaspeed / Huang affair: board independent investigation and FBI probe (target unspecified); CEO Jensen Huang resigned 11 Nov 2026; no charge, regulatory action or finding against NVIDIA
Congressional inquiry (Wyden/Neal) to Commerce Department on NVIDIA H200 export approvals to China; directed at Commerce, not NVIDIA
Kistenmacher v. NVIDIA, N.D. Cal. securities class action (5:26-cv-13448) alleging concealment of Huang's Megaspeed relationship and misleading statements on Megaspeed dealings
US DOJ Antitrust Division inquiring into ~$12.93bn Hugging Face acquisition amid years-long conduct investigation (acquisitions, investments, sales practices); no complaint filed
US DOJ reportedly investigating whether ~$20bn non-exclusive Groq licensing deal was structured to avoid merger review
French Competition Authority antitrust investigation (CUDA lock-in, investments in AI cloud providers; began with 2023 raid); rapporteur says nearing end, no statement of objections or decision found
Nazemian et al. v. NVIDIA, N.D. Cal. copyright class action over AI training data; court dismissed vicarious infringement but let direct and contributory claims proceed
In re NVIDIA Corporation Securities Litigation (N.D. Cal. 4:18-cv-07669) over 2017-2018 crypto-mining demand statements; class certified 25 Mar 2026, no settlement or verdict, no liability accrued
Valeo v. NVIDIA, N.D. Cal. trade-secret suit over allegedly stolen driving-assistance code; settled on undisclosed terms, NVIDIA denied the claims
China SAMR preliminary finding that NVIDIA did not fully comply with Mellanox merger conditions (Anti-Monopoly Law); further investigation, no final decision or fine
US SEC cease-and-desist order and $5.5m penalty for failing to disclose crypto-mining as a driver of gaming revenue in two FY2018 10-Qs (no admission or denial)
US FTC sued to block the $40bn Arm acquisition; NVIDIA and SoftBank abandoned the deal, no misconduct finding or penalty
